title: Relata: fixture events arrive as typed rows
summary: Creates 3 small known attack-event files, loads them into the local Relata with the real relata sink, then reads them back and checks the typed fields (event id, city, state, group, attack type). Only these 3 fixture rows are added to Relata.

source.label: 3 fixture event .md files (marker S02-<run>)
source.detail: scenarios/fixtures/s02, copied to a temp folder

steps.title: Write the 3 fixture files with a unique marker
steps.explain: Each run gets its own marker so its rows can be told apart from any other data.

steps.title: Look for the marker in Relata (Before)
steps.explain: Before the run Relata must hold no row with this marker.

args.sql: SELECT event_id, attack_date, city, state, group_name, attack_type, target_type, weapon_type, primary_source FROM TerrorAttackEvent WHERE summary_text LIKE '%${stage.marker}%' ORDER BY event_id

steps.title: Run the pipeline into Relata
steps.explain: Runs the real pipeline with the relata sink against the local Relata.

steps.title: Job finished with status COMPLETED
steps.explain: A clean run is COMPLETED.

steps.title: Job reported no warnings
steps.explain: Warnings would mean rows were skipped or quarantined.

steps.title: Job read all 3 fixture files
steps.explain: All three input files must be read.

steps.title: Read the rows back from Relata (After)
steps.explain: Reads what Relata actually stored for this marker.

args.sql: SELECT event_id, attack_date, city, state, group_name, attack_type, target_type, weapon_type, primary_source FROM TerrorAttackEvent WHERE summary_text LIKE '%${stage.marker}%' ORDER BY event_id

steps.title: Count the stored rows
steps.explain: Exactly 3 typed rows must exist for this marker: no loss, no duplicates.
